Rashi on Nedarim 25a:12:1.hebrew: אם כן, אמאי משבע יתהון הכי: על דעת המקום ועל דעתי? לישבע יתהון דמקיימיתו תורה:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:12:1.english: If so, why does he administer an oath to them like this: "According to the mind of the Omnipresent and according to my mind"? Let him administer an oath to them: "That you fulfill the Torah"!

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:12:2.english: It would indicate one Torah - [the Written Torah] alone.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:12:3.english: [It] indicates the commandments of the king - [Namely, those] in the section "You shall surely set a king over you" (Deuteronomy 17:15), for there are commandments there.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:14:1.hebrew: ולישבע להו הכי דמקיימיתו עבודת כובבים ותורה כולה אי נמי דמקיימיתו תרי"ג מצות - ולא מצי למיטעי מידי:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:14:1.english: And let him administer an oath to them thus: That you fulfill [the prohibition of] idol worship and the entire Torah, or alternatively, that you fulfill [the] six hundred and thirteen mitzvot - And they would not be able to err at all.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:14:2.hebrew: אלא משה רבינו מילתא דלאו טירחא נקט - כשאמר על דעת המקום ועל דעתי, ששם נכלל הכל:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:14:2.english: Rather, Moses our teacher took a matter that is not troublesome - When he said, "Upon the understanding of the Omnipresent and upon my understanding," for everything is included therein.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:15:2.english: And it swallowed them - Evidently it was larger than the beam of an olive press.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:15:3.english: He is speaking of a taruf [snake] - A spotted snake is not found [as large] as the beam of an olive press.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:15:4.english: But all of them are spotted - They were spotted.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:15:5.english: We are saying [it is] notched on its back - And there is no [snake] as large as this.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:16:1.english: And let [the Mishnah] teach - "If I did not see a snake [whose] back is notched like the beam of an olive press."

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:16:2.hebrew: מילתא אגב אורחא קמ"ל - דכי אמר בית הבד, אגבו טרוף קאמר, דומיא דקורת בית הבד, דהוי טרוף חדקים חדקים:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:16:2.english: He teaches us a matter in passing - For when he said "olive press," he was referring to its notched back, similar to the beam of an olive press, which is notched [with] many slits.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:16:3.english: [The practical] difference - For one who sells the beam of an olive press to another.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:16:4.english: If its back is notched, yes - [It] is certainly a beam of an olive press.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:1:1.hebrew: אדעתא דידן אישתבע - כדרך שבני אדם נשבעין, ואין דרך בני אדם לקרוא לנמלים עולי מצרים:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:1:1.english: He swore based on our understanding - In the manner that people swear, and it is not the way of people to call ants "those who went up from Egypt."

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:2:1.english: To exclude what - do they say this to him, that "we do not administer an oath to you according to your understanding"?

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:2:2.hebrew: לאו לאפוקי - דיהיב ליה לבעל חובו אסקונדרי — פיספסים שמשחקים בהן — וקרא אותן זוזי, ובכך רוצה לפטור עצמו מן השבועה. מכלל דעביד איניש דנשבע לדעתא דנפשיה, הכא נמי נימא הכי גבי שומשמני:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:2:2.english: Is it not to exclude - [a case] where he gave his creditor iskundarei — game pieces with which people play — and he called them zuzim [coins], and thereby he wishes to exempt himself from the oath. [This implies] by inference that a person commonly swears according to his own understanding; here too, let us say thus regarding ants.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:4:1.hebrew: לא - שומשמני ואיסקונדרי לאו מילתא היא, ובהכי לא מיפטר איניש נפשיה, ומשום האי טעמא לא היו אומרים לו "הוי יודע" כו':
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:4:1.english: No - Sesame seeds and game tokens are of no consequence, and through such things a person does not exempt himself [from his obligation]; and for this reason they would not say to him, "Know [that we do not administer an oath...]," etc.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:4:2.hebrew: אלא לאפוקי מקניא דרבא - דזוזי ממש יהב ובעי למיפטר בהכי, ובשאר מילי לא עביד איניש דנשבע אדעתא דנפשיה:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:4:2.english: Rather, [it comes] to exclude [a case like] the cane of Rava - For he actually gave [him] real zuzim and sought to exempt himself thereby, whereas in other matters a person would not swear according to his own private intent.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:7:1.hebrew: והא תניא וכן מצינו כו' שנאמר ולא אתכם לבדכם - הכי פירושו, איני משביע אתכם על דעתכם לבדכם:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:7:1.english: But isn't it taught: And so we found, etc., as it is stated: "Neither with you only" - This is its explanation: I do not administer an oath to you according to your understanding alone.

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:8:1.hebrew: לאפוקי מאי - קאמר להו הכי? לאו לאפוקי דאי אסיקו לה שמא לעבודת כוכבים "אלוה", ופלחו לה, ובעו למיפטר נפשייהו דאמרי דפלחי לאלוה:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:8:1.english: To exclude what - did he say this to them? Is it not to exclude [a case] where they give an idol the name "God," and worship it, and seek to exempt themselves, for they say that they worship "God."

Rashi on Nedarim 25a:8:2.hebrew: לא - לאו לאפוקי משום האי קאמר הכי, דאינהו לא מצו לאסוקי לעבודת כוכבים שמא אלוה ולמפטר נפשייהו, דהא עבודת כוכבים איקרי אלוה מעצמה:
Rashi on Nedarim 25a:8:2.english: No - He did not say so to exclude [a case] because of this [reason], for they cannot give idol worship the name "God" and exempt themselves, since idol worship is called "God" on its own.

Tosafot on Nedarim 25a:15:1.hebrew: בטרוף - פי' שהוא מנומר, שהיו כמו קורות בית הבד. ול"נ, דמה ענין מנומר לקורות בית הבד? לכ"נ לפרש בטרוף: פלט"ר בלע"ז. ופריך: כולהו נמי טרופין! פירוש: בבטן. ולכך ניחא גבי קורות בית הבד:
Tosafot on Nedarim 25a:15:1.english: Betaruf - [Rashi] explained that it means spotted, that they were like the beams of an olive press. And it does not seem [correct] to me, for what connection does "spotted" have to the beams of an olive press? Therefore, it seems [correct] to me to explain betaruf as plater [flat] in Old French. And [the Gemara] asks: "All [snakes] are also flat!" Explanation: [that refers to] on the belly. And therefore it fits well with "the beams of an olive press."
